visible_text: 4. 若 k 為一常數使得 x^3 + 4x^2 + kx - 12 被 x+3 整除，則 k = ? A. -25 B. -1 C. 1 D. 17
reasoning: Since the polynomial is divisible by x+3, -3 is a root. Substituting x = -3 gives (-3)^3 + 4(-3)^2 + k(-3) - 12 = -27 + 36 - 3k - 12 = -3 - 3k = 0, so -3(1 + k) = 0 and k = -1, which corresponds to option B.
